title: Architect of Destruction
cn: 第 5 集 · 毁灭建筑师
novel: Ted was [[thrilled|thrill]] when he was chosen to design the new GNB headquarters. It was the biggest project of his career. However, everything changed when he met Zoey, a [[passionate|passionate]] woman who was determined to save the Arcadian, a historic building that would be [[demolished|demolish]] to make room for the new tower. Zoey [[protested|protest]] outside the construction site with a megaphone and a group of [[supporters|supporter]]. She told Ted that the Arcadian was a [[treasure|treasure]] of New York City and that tearing it down would be a [[tragedy|tragedy]]. Ted felt [[conflicted|conflict]] for the first time. He admired Zoey's [[dedication|dedication]] and found himself drawn to her energy. He started to question whether he could design a building that would [[destroy|destroy]] something so important. Barney, on the other hand, was [[furious|furious]]. He told Ted that the GNB project was worth millions and that he should not let a [[protester|protester]] change his mind. Ted and Barney had a heated argument about [[preservation|preservation]] versus progress. Ted [[researched|research]] the Arcadian's history and discovered that it was indeed an architectural [[gem|gem]]. He felt even more [[uncertain|uncertain]] about his role in the project. Zoey invited Ted to join her group, but he [[hesitated|hesitate]]. He knew that accepting would mean [[betraying|betray]] his client and his career. The episode ended with Ted standing in front of the Arcadian, staring up at its old stone facade, torn between his [[ambition|ambition]] and his [[conscience|conscience]].

thrill.en: to make someone feel very excited

passionate.en: having very strong feelings about something

protest.en: to say or show that you disagree with something

supporter.en: a person who agrees with and helps someone

tragedy.en: a very sad event that causes suffering

conflict.en: to feel torn between two choices

dedication.en: the quality of working hard at something

destroy.en: to damage something so it no longer exists

protester.en: a person who shows public disagreement

preservation.en: the act of keeping something safe from harm

research.en: to study something carefully to learn facts

gem.en: something that is very special and valuable

uncertain.en: not sure about what will happen

ambition.en: a strong desire to achieve something

conscience.en: your sense of what is right and wrong

betray.en: to hurt someone who trusts you
